The exact PSp(4,3) apartment action has stabilizer order 16 and 131 orbitals with size census 1^2,2^3,4^17,8^25,16^84; 25 are self-transpose and 53 occur in directed transpose pairs. The complete orbital intersection tensor has 159065 nonzero entries and SHA256 868ffd6ea89ab41b95557cdd97b4ffca6198771238a0bb0f8c006974c7885b19. The orbital-algebra center has exact dimension 17.

Pass5438: reconciled with the already-owned Pass5079 all-q Tanner six-cycle theorem instead of duplicating it. The overlap-4 apartment graph is edge-regular: degree 8(q-1), exactly q-1 triangles through every edge, split as one theta triangle plus q-2 root/Tanner triangles; total triangles T(q)(q-1).

Pass5439: proved a cardinality-optimal structured sparse apartment basis for every GQ(q,q). Any BFS geodesic spanning tree has q^4 cotree edges and every cotree fundamental cycle is an 8-cycle apartment, hence q^4 apartments form a minimum H1 basis. At q=3 this is 81 apartments versus the full 1620-frame family.
